summary.name: Claude Statistics
summary.one_liner: A native macOS menu bar app that tracks local AI coding history and quota usage across Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI, with a notch-docked live activity view.
keywords: account switcher for claude codex gemini
how to see claude code token usage on mac
use_cases: Monitor Claude Code quota windows before hitting limits
Review token and cost usage across AI coding CLIs
Approve or deny Claude Code permission requests from the notch
Switch between managed Claude, Codex, or Gemini accounts
Search past coding sessions and transcripts
summary.what_it_does: It parses local JSONL transcripts from Claude Code and local files from Codex CLI and Gemini CLI to show sessions, token and model breakdowns, and cost. For Claude it fetches 5-hour, 7-day, and per-model usage windows from Anthropic's OAuth API; Gemini quota buckets are shown with local trend charts. It displays live session status and can show Allow/Deny cards for Claude Code permission requests, and jump to the matching terminal tab. It can also manage several accounts per provider and switch the live account, and installs verified plugins from an official catalog to add providers or subscription endpoints.
notable: Notch-docked live activity view with permission Allow/Deny cards written back via hook protocol
Tab-accurate focus for Ghostty, iTerm2, and Terminal
Plugin marketplace with SHA-256 and manifest verification before hot-loading
Account switching for Claude, Codex, and Gemini CLIs
caveats: Requires macOS; installation via DMG from GitHub Releases or building from source with XcodeGen and Xcode 16+
Pricing not stated on the page
